name: archboard-painter-wasm
responsibility: The Painter class that a page holds: one stage and the canvas its frames land on, painted by Vello on WebGPU, by Vello GPU on WebGL2 or by Vello on the CPU
description: A page asks it to show, carry, enter, leave or dive a picture, to set the camera, the light and the marks, to pick under a point and to draw a frame for a time. This crate is a browser's: a native build of the workspace compiles it empty. It carries the hash of the sources it was built from, and the page refuses a build of other sources.
